<p>A <strong>list of proxy servers</strong> describes all about the open HTTP/ SOCKS/ HTTPS proxy servers, their port and uptime of servers managed on a single website. It permits us to access the internet via indirect network connections. The list of proxy servers consists of computer IP addresses some of them host free proxy servers. The free <a href="https://www.javatpoint.com/what-is-a-proxy-server-and-how-does-it-work">proxy server</a> can be accessed by anyone who is connected through a network.</p>
<p>In this section, we have enlisted some proxy servers that can be used with software applications that support the use of proxies such as web browsers. The purpose of using a proxy is that masking the <a href="https://www.javatpoint.com/ip">IP</a> address of the system, hiding the geolocation of the user, allows the user to access the blocked content or website.</p>
<p>Most of the proxy lists includes web proxies that can be accessed without making any change in browser settings. The following tables shows the list of open <a href="https://www.javatpoint.com/http-tutorial">HTTP</a> IP addresses where those are freely available.</p>
<img src="https://static.javatpoint.com/tutorial/computer-network/images/proxy-server-list.png" alt="Proxy Server List" />
<p>If you are planning to <a href="https://www.javatpoint.com/how-to-set-up-and-use-a-proxy-server">configure a proxy server</a>, first you should know about the following factors that will help you to select the right proxy server.</p>
<li><strong>Port:</strong> Port is a two or four-digit number that allows the user to connect with the proxy server. It is mandatory while establishing a proxy connection.</li>
<li><strong>Uptime:</strong> Uptime is a measure of system <strong>reliability</strong>, expressed as the <strong>percentage</strong> of time a machine, typically a computer has been <strong>working</strong> and <strong>available</strong>. In short, we can say that uptime refers to the amount of time, the server is available for use as intended.</li>
<li><strong>Proxy Speed:</strong> Proxy speed significantly affects the <strong>pace</strong> of the round trip (involves too many components in addition to the proxy) for an Internet data request. Commercial proxy services promote the processing speed of their proxy servers. The speed of servers measured in <strong>seconds</strong> or <strong>milliseconds</strong>.</li>
<li><strong>Anonymity:</strong> There are three types of anonymity
<li><strong>Transparent:</strong> If proxy anonymity is <strong>transparent</strong>, it means that the target server knows the IP address of the system that we are using and also knows that the user is connected via proxy server.</li>
<li><strong>Anonymous:</strong> If proxy anonymity is <strong>anonymous</strong>, it means that the target server does not know the IP address of the system that we are using and also knows that the user is connected via proxy server.</li>
<li><strong>Elite:</strong> If proxy anonymity is <strong>elite</strong>, it means that the target server does not know the IP address of the system that we are using and also knows that the request is relayed via proxy server.</li>

<p>A <strong>list of proxy servers</strong> describes all about the open HTTP/ SOCKS/ HTTPS proxy servers, their port and uptime of servers managed on a single website. It permits us to access the internet via indirect network connections. The list of proxy servers consists of computer IP addresses some of them host free proxy servers. The free <a href="https://www.javatpoint.com/what-is-a-proxy-server-and-how-does-it-work">proxy server</a> can be accessed by anyone who is connected through a network.</p>
<p>In this section, we have enlisted some proxy servers that can be used with software applications that support the use of proxies such as web browsers. The purpose of using a proxy is that masking the <a href="https://www.javatpoint.com/ip">IP</a> address of the system, hiding the geolocation of the user, allows the user to access the blocked content or website.</p>
<p>Most of the proxy lists includes web proxies that can be accessed without making any change in browser settings. The following tables shows the list of open <a href="https://www.javatpoint.com/http-tutorial">HTTP</a> IP addresses where those are freely available.</p>
<img src="https://static.javatpoint.com/tutorial/computer-network/images/proxy-server-list.png" alt="Proxy Server List" />
<p>If you are planning to <a href="https://www.javatpoint.com/how-to-set-up-and-use-a-proxy-server">configure a proxy server</a>, first you should know about the following factors that will help you to select the right proxy server.</p>
<li><strong>Port:</strong> Port is a two or four-digit number that allows the user to connect with the proxy server. It is mandatory while establishing a proxy connection.</li>
<li><strong>Uptime:</strong> Uptime is a measure of system <strong>reliability</strong>, expressed as the <strong>percentage</strong> of time a machine, typically a computer has been <strong>working</strong> and <strong>available</strong>. In short, we can say that uptime refers to the amount of time, the server is available for use as intended.</li>
<li><strong>Proxy Speed:</strong> Proxy speed significantly affects the <strong>pace</strong> of the round trip (involves too many components in addition to the proxy) for an Internet data request. Commercial proxy services promote the processing speed of their proxy servers. The speed of servers measured in <strong>seconds</strong> or <strong>milliseconds</strong>.</li>
<li><strong>Anonymity:</strong> There are three types of anonymity
<li><strong>Transparent:</strong> If proxy anonymity is <strong>transparent</strong>, it means that the target server knows the IP address of the system that we are using and also knows that the user is connected via proxy server.</li>
<li><strong>Anonymous:</strong> If proxy anonymity is <strong>anonymous</strong>, it means that the target server does not know the IP address of the system that we are using and also knows that the user is connected via proxy server.</li>
<li><strong>Elite:</strong> If proxy anonymity is <strong>elite</strong>, it means that the target server does not know the IP address of the system that we are using and also knows that the request is relayed via proxy server.</li>
